AstraZeneca Pharma India Partners with Reliance Subsidiary Strand Life Sciences

AstraZeneca Pharma India has entered into a partnership with Strand Life Sciences, a subsidiary of Reliance Industries. The collaboration aims to explore opportunities within the healthcare sector. Specific details of the partnership's objectives or the scope of the collaboration were not provided in the coverage.
